title: The predicted interactome of the human mitochondrial proteome.
authors: Swaminathan, Abhinav B; Zulkifli, Mohammad; Guerra, Rachel M; Calabrese, Sofia M; Kalafatis, Dimitris T; Pagliarini, David J; Gohil, Vishal M
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold Multimer对整个人类线粒体蛋白质组进行大规模相互作用预测，构建相互作用组图谱，属于蛋白质结构预测方法在蛋白质相互作用问题上的应用，与蛋白质结构计算课题高度相关。
abstract: Despite the fundamental importance of mitochondria in cellular metabolism, the molecular function(s) of many mitochondrial proteins remain unknown. Since protein function can be inferred from their interacting partners, we repurpose the protein structure prediction algorithm AlphaFold Multimer (AFM) as a classification model to predict protein-protein interactions of the entire human mitochondrial proteome. By screening 630,003 protein pairs, we create a compendium of 2,895 previously known and newly observed interactions, which include the interacting partner(s) of 85 uncharacterized mitochondrial proteins, thereby linking them to a known biochemical pathway. Extending the AFM-based analysis to 11 diverse eukaryotes identifies evolutionarily conserved interactions among human hits, including regulators of core bioenergetic pathways. Our experiments, guided by these predictions, nominate protein interactions that form the coenzyme Q metabolon and define the mitochondrial copper delivery pathway to cytochrome c oxidase. Our compendium represents a powerful resource for the systematic, structure-based functionalization of the human mitochondrial proteome.
abstract_zh: 尽管线粒体在细胞代谢中具有根本重要性，但许多线粒体蛋白的分子功能仍属未知。由于蛋白质功能可从其相互作用伙伴推断，我们将蛋白质结构预测算法AlphaFold Multimer (AFM)重新用作分类模型，以预测整个人类线粒体蛋白质组的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。通过筛选630,003对蛋白质，我们构建了一个包含2,895个已知和新观察到的相互作用的汇编，其中包括85个未表征线粒体蛋白的相互作用伙伴，从而将它们与已知生化途径联系起来。将基于AFM的分析扩展到11种多样的真核生物，识别出人类命中中进化上保守的相互作用，包括核心生物能量途径的调节因子。我们的实验在这些预测的指导下，提名了形成辅酶Q代谢体（coenzyme Q metabolon）的蛋白质相互作用，并定义了向细胞色素c氧化酶的线粒体铜递送途径。我们的汇编代表了系统、基于结构的人类线粒体蛋白质组功能化的强大资源。
